long_biography.plain_text:
At 18, Konstantinas Karosas assumed responsibility for the bank interest built by his father, Saulius Karosas. The succession placed a regulated financial institution at the centre of his public business identity before he had established an independent career. European Central Bank clearance later formalised the qualifying holdings of Karosas and his wholly owned Western Petroleum Limited.

Urbo Bank is overseen by a supervisory council, management board and chief executive rather than by Karosas personally. He also transferred shareholder voting rights to MB Valdymas, separating his economic stake from their exercise at general meetings. That structure makes him an heir and controlling shareholder, while leaving daily lending, risk and administration to professional managers.
